data.title: Housing application form due 3 June 2026
data.summary: The Musterfield Exchange Programme wrote on 2 February 2026 about your housing application. The completed housing form is due on 03/06/2026, and later forms go on the waiting list.
data.explanation: After you accepted your place, the programme asks you to send in the completed housing form. The letter gives the due date as 03/06/2026, which is ambiguous: it could be 3 June or 6 March 2026. I read it as 3 June 2026, but please confirm with the admissions office (admissions@musterfield-exchange.example). Forms that arrive after the due date go on the waiting list, so it is safest to submit early, before the earlier possible date.

items.action: Submit the completed housing form to the exchange programme.
items.consequence: Forms that arrive later are put on the waiting list.
